# {{< meta gh.repo >}}: {{< meta tagline >}}

{{< include /docs/includes/_badges.qmd >}}

Sprout is one component of the [Seedcase Project](https://seedcase-project.org)
framework that aims to take data created or collected for research studies and
"grow" it in a structured way using modern data engineering best practices.
Sprout is designed to organise, describe, and store data for effective
discovery, management, and analysis.

Check out our [website]({{< meta links.site >}}) for more information, such as
the features it provides and a [guide]({{< meta links.site >}}/docs/guide) to
using the package. For a list of changes, see our [changelog](CHANGELOG.md).
